goal: In gateway/config.py, load optional environment defaults from gateway/config_overrides.json at import time, without overriding variables that are already set.
requirements: After the load_dotenv call on line 13, read the file ROOT / 'gateway' / 'config_overrides.json' as UTF-8 text, where ROOT is the repository root already defined in the file.
If the file exists and parses as a JSON object, then for each key of its 'env' object, set os.environ[key] to the string value only when that variable is not already set.
A variable that is already set in the process environment keeps its value.
A missing or invalid file is ignored silently: no exception, no output and no change to the environment.
Change no other behaviour of gateway/config.py and add no other file.
context: Python 3.11. Insert the new code after line 13 (load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")). The overrides file is optional and is looked up under the repository root only: ROOT / "gateway" / "config_overrides.json". Its top-level value is a JSON object; its optional key env maps names to string values. A variable is set when os.environ has it.
